text:
deploy-bot: Canary finished for frontend-service: chart=frontend-2.8.0, canary pods=3/3. Observed config values hash drift: values.hash=abc123 -> values.hash=def456. Subchart 'payments' version mismatch: expected 1.2.1, found 1.2.3. Auto-rollforward blocked by policy 'subchart-pin'.

alex: saw a tiny spike in 502s during canary rollout window, nothing huge but correlated with pod restarts. logs show `invalid signature` errors for a short period.

sabrina: that lines up with the secret key rotation we applied in staging. Did we include the new secret mapping in the new chart?

marco: payments subchart bumped because of a dependency bump in the chart repo. CI published 1.2.3 yesterday; we didn't pin it in values.yaml.

alex: quick logs snippet: ```
[2025-05-03T15:12:07Z] auth: signature verification failed for token xyz
[2025-05-03T15:12:09Z] retried auth and succeeded
```

jenna: options: 1) rollback frontend->2.7.0 (fast, safe), 2) patch canary values to pin payments=1.2.1 and re-run canary, 3) hotpatch secret mapping in 2.8.0 (riskier). We should also update release notes to mention subchart change and secret rotation guidance.

ops-oncall: we prefer minimal blast radius. If we can pin subchart and re-run canary quickly within change window, that's ideal. Rollback if re-run still shows errors. Current change window open until 18:00 UTC.

sabrina: I can prepare a values override: `payments.version: 1.2.1` and apply as a canary-only override. Will need manual approval to bypass auto-rollforward policy.

alex: also add a preflight check to verify secret keys present: `kubectl get secret auth-keys -o yaml` in canary namespace. If missing, abort.

jenna: ok I'm release manager for this window. Approve manual pin+canary re-run. @deploy-bot hold rollback for 30m while patch is applied. :+1:

deploy-bot: Manual hold acknowledged by policy. Waiting for `sabrina` override to be submitted.

sabrina: submitted override patch and a dry-run command: ```
helm upgrade --install frontend ./charts/frontend --set payments.version=1.2.1 --namespace canary-frontend --dry-run
```

sabrina: applied the override to canary namespace. Preflight secret check passed: secret `auth-keys` contains keys v2 and v1.

deploy-bot: Re-running canary with pinned payments=1.2.1. Canary target: 3 pods. Monitoring 15m.

marco: I'll update the release notes draft to mention: "2.8.0 includes payments subchart; pinned to 1.2.1 in canary due to live secret rotation; follow upgrade guide for secret rollover."

docs-bot: Draft release notes link: https://redwood-internal/release-notes/frontend/2.8.0 (added section about secret mapping and rollback instructions).

ops-oncall: watching metrics. will call rollback immediately if 5xx > 1% sustained for 5m.

alex: current canary logs look clean, 502s back to baseline.

deploy-bot: Canary completed rerun: 3/3 healthy, no signature errors observed in last 20m. Auto-rollforward still blocked by subchart policy. Please confirm next action.

jenna: proceed with gradual rollforward to 50% then 100% with a 10m watch at each step. Keep pinned override in place until next scheduled maintenance where we can do a full subchart dependency bump and communicate in notes.

sabrina: will schedule a follow-up ticket to bump payments properly and coordinate secret migration with security.

marco: adding a note to the chart repo to prevent implicit payments bumps in future: add `dependencies.lock` update step in CI.

jenna: thanks team. I'll close the hold and mark release notes ready. @deploy-bot start rollforward to 50%.

deploy-bot: Rollforward started: stage=50%. Monitoring enabled. Will post status updates.

alex: nice one, team.

ops-oncall: :white_check_mark: all good so far.
